scope: Prepare a generic independently developed OS-agnostic C++17 JSON5/strict-JSON library for compatible hosted and embedded projects. Errors are explicit results, never thrown. Schema/CLI/editor remain optional. Agents may prepare CMake, GoogleTest, docs, requirements and skills; no production C++.
requirement_status: Draft; creating issues does not promote proposal requirements to Agreed or establish implementation evidence.
quality_scope: GoogleTest units and formatting only; one job each on pull requests; exceptions OFF and RTTI OFF.
license: Retain the existing Apache-2.0 repository license. MIT in the source proposal is a proposed choice, not authorization to change the current license. Preserve third-party notices and pinned provenance.
adaptations: The latest user scope replaces WSL/AdaptivePi SDK/runtime/deployment obligations with a generic portable C++17 library for compatible projects.

J5-083 through J5-090 describe an optional reference profile/example, isolated from the core, rather than a required AdaptivePi infrastructure integration. Preserve consumer-policy separation and traceability to the original proposal; recheck consumer-owned assumptions before describing that example as compatible.
J5-091 is adapted to native Windows/Linux/macOS compiler portability and portable cross-compilation support, without mandating a particular ARM64 SDK or deployment path.
J5-092/J5-093 retain reusable packaging and immutable dependency/source versions without introducing AdaptivePi dependencies.
J5-095 external fixture evidence is implemented through pinned representative fixture unit tests only; automatic differential/reference-tool jobs are superseded.
J5-097 fuzzing and sanitizer evidence is deferred; deterministic boundary, truncation, transformation and regression unit cases remain in scope.
J5-098 allocation/limit/cancellation failure injection remains an in-process unit-test responsibility.
J5-082 installed VS Code and Remote SSH end-to-end acceptance is deferred; language-service components and host/runtime fixture parity receive unit tests.

J5-099 the original Yocto/QEMU, sanitizer and installed-consumer integration matrix is superseded; document compatible native C++17 toolchains and run the selected unit tests in supported exception configurations.
J5-100 measured footprint/throughput benchmarking is deferred; release documentation must describe only implemented and unit-tested capabilities.
New J5-101 records the explicit OS-agnostic embedded requirement. Host unit evidence is not target certification or proof of a embedded runtime integration.

MICROSAR is an example only. OS independence and compilation into compatible embedded projects are the requirement; no dedicated vendor port, SDK or workflow is needed. All library errors shall use non-throwing explicit outcomes even in an exception-enabled consumer.

milestones.title: 1. Portable foundations
milestones.description: Settle draft contracts, portable C++17 targets, Apache-2.0 provenance and unit-test/formatting workflow.

milestones.title: 2. JSON5 and strict JSON reader
milestones.description: Implement complete grammar, owned values, exact numbers and precise recoverable errors.

milestones.title: 3. Resource and failure contracts
milestones.description: Recoverable allocation, explicit limits, bounded work, reusable contexts and deterministic semantics.

milestones.title: 4. Optional Draft-07 validator
milestones.description: Implement an independently buildable offline schema component with exact assertion/reference semantics.

milestones.title: 5. Host CLI and VS Code
milestones.description: Provide usable diagnostics, offline schema assistance and incomplete-document editing through optional host components.

milestones.title: 6. Optional consumer example
milestones.description: Demonstrate externally applied profile/schema policy without coupling the generic library to an application.

milestones.title: 7. Portable packaging and release
milestones.description: Publish reusable CMake targets, supported compiler documentation and truthful unit-test traceability.

issues.title: Define the public C++17 API and draft behavior contracts
issues.goal: Define reviewed C++17 public API contracts and types for explicit bytes/length, syntax defaults, results, ownership, exact numbers, errors and allocation before a developer implements the production reader. Agent work is documentation and planned GoogleTest cases only; production C++ belongs to the developer. All library errors use non-throwing explicit outcomes in every supported compiler exception mode.
acceptance: Public headers use portable standard C++17 and expose no AdaptivePi, WSL, host-tool or editor types.

Document exact-length/read-only/non-NUL-terminated input semantics and mode/result defaults; add API/configuration GoogleTest cases as the corresponding declarations become available. Complete parse behavior is verified by subsequent grammar issues.

Specify that syntax, conversion/access, allocation and limit errors return explicit outcomes and never throw in any supported build; exception-enabled consumers use the same API. Invalid input must not assert or abort. Complete runtime cases land with the implemented reader.
Document syntax defaults, ownership/views, duplicate policy, conversions, error categories, limits and thread-safety; unresolved choices remain Draft.
notes: Compatible C++17 projects are the supported goal; do not promise every historical C++ implementation.
Public-contract umbrella retained; P001 library target completion is issue #68.

issues.title: Non-throwing result foundation
issues.goal: Define success/error alternatives with stable minimal error code and byte offset; returning any failure shall not require allocation or throw.
issues.unit_cases: Unit-test minimal result construction in exceptions OFF; no parser needed.

issues.title: Fallible storage and accounting
issues.goal: Provide caller-supplied fallible storage, checked size arithmetic, ownership and cleanup primitives before implementing growing parser structures.
issues.unit_cases: Fail each primitive allocation and verify explicit outcomes and balanced release.

issues.title: Explicit input cursor
issues.goal: Consume immutable bytes with explicit length and end position; bound every read and preserve original byte locations.
issues.unit_cases: Empty, embedded-zero and truncated buffers; no terminating NUL assumption.

issues.title: Unicode source decoding
issues.goal: Decode the project UTF-8 transport to source characters without replacement; retain byte-to-source mapping.
issues.unit_cases: Malformed, overlong, surrogate-encoded and out-of-range UTF-8; supplementary characters.

issues.title: Character classification
issues.goal: Establish documented Unicode data for source classification used by whitespace and IdentifierName; classification has no locale dependency.
issues.unit_cases: Category boundaries, non-ASCII and non-BMP handling; document supported Unicode version.

issues.title: Line terminators
issues.goal: Recognize LF, CR, CRLF, U+2028 and U+2029 as line terminator sequences; keep CRLF as one sequence for location/continuation purposes.
issues.unit_cases: Each sequence and EOF after CR; assert source spans.

issues.title: Whitespace
issues.goal: Skip HT, VT, FF, SP, NBSP, BOM and other Unicode Zs whitespace, together with line terminators, between tokens.
issues.unit_cases: Each admitted space before/after tokens; BOM both leading and between tokens.

issues.title: Line comments
issues.goal: Skip // comments until a line terminator or EOF; comments are trivia rather than values.
issues.unit_cases: All terminators, empty comment and EOF comment; validate non-ASCII source.

issues.title: Block comments
issues.goal: Skip /* comments through the first */; do not nest comments, and report unterminated comments.
issues.unit_cases: First closer, embedded opener and EOF at every suffix position.

issues.title: Trivia composition
issues.goal: Permit any sequence of admitted spaces, line terminators and comments before/after tokens, without joining split tokens.
issues.unit_cases: Mixed trivia; comments between tokens; 1/*x*/2 remains two tokens.

issues.title: Punctuation tokens
issues.goal: Recognize exactly the structural punctuators { } [ ] : , outside strings/comments.
issues.unit_cases: Every punctuator, adjacent punctuators and original spans.

issues.title: String storage
issues.goal: Provide owned length-aware decoded-unit storage, preserving UTF-16 escape units including lone surrogates; define allocation-failure behavior.
issues.unit_cases: Empty, NUL, supplementary scalar and unpaired unit round-trips without UTF-8 substitution.

issues.title: Quoted string boundaries
issues.goal: Recognize single/double-quoted strings with matching closing delimiters; allow the other quote and ordinary source characters, rejecting raw CR/LF and unterminated strings.
issues.unit_cases: Both delimiters, opposite quote, raw tab/control characters, raw CR/LF and EOF.

issues.title: Simple character escapes
issues.goal: Decode escaped quotes, reverse solidus, b/f/n/r/t/v and zero; zero is valid only when not followed by a decimal digit.
issues.unit_cases: Each decoded unit; accept zero at quote/EOF boundary only where the complete string is valid; reject zero followed by any digit.

issues.title: Hexadecimal string escapes
issues.goal: Decode x followed by exactly two hexadecimal digits, in either hex-letter case; reject incomplete or nonhex escapes.
issues.unit_cases: Lower/upper hex letters, boundary bytes and every truncation.

issues.title: Unicode string escapes
issues.goal: Decode u followed by exactly four hexadecimal digits; preserve individual units and support escaped surrogate pairs.
issues.unit_cases: BMP, paired/lone/reversed surrogate units and malformed/truncated hex.

issues.title: Non-escape characters
issues.goal: For permitted characters without a special escape production, omit the reverse solidus and retain the character; reject escaped digits 1–9.
issues.unit_cases: a/e/slash/space yield those characters; 8/9 fail; x/u cannot fall back after malformed escape.

issues.title: String line continuations
issues.goal: Remove the reverse solidus and the following complete line terminator sequence from the decoded string.
issues.unit_cases: LF, CR, CRLF, U+2028/U+2029 join unchanged surrounding text.

issues.title: Raw separator warnings
issues.goal: Accept unescaped U+2028/U+2029 in strings and produce a warning without changing successful parsing.
issues.unit_cases: Both raw separators, escaped equivalents, original warning spans and successful value.

issues.title: Complete string lexer
issues.goal: Compose all string alternatives, validate delimiters and input consumption, and report lexical failures atomically.
issues.unit_cases: Combine escapes/continuations; truncation at each byte; no partial successful string.

issues.title: IdentifierName tokens
issues.goal: Recognize ES5 IdentifierName, including $, _, admitted Unicode starts/parts, ZWNJ/ZWJ continuation and reserved-word names.
issues.unit_cases: Category representatives, digit-first rejection and reserved-word tokens.

issues.title: Identifier Unicode escapes
issues.goal: Decode identifier uXXXX escapes before checking start/part legality and member-name equality.
issues.unit_cases: Escaped valid names, illegal escaped start/part and equal decoded names.

issues.title: Null and boolean classification
issues.goal: Classify lowercase null, true and false as value literals; preserve their admissibility as object IdentifierName tokens.
issues.unit_cases: Exact spellings versus case/suffix variants; key-versus-value context classified without parsing containers.

issues.title: Decimal numeric tokens
issues.goal: Recognize decimal integer, fraction and exponent alternatives, including leading/trailing decimal points and optional leading sign; reject illegal leading zeros and missing exponent digits.
issues.unit_cases: 0/-0/+1/.5/5./5.e2/1E-2; reject 01, ., 1e and doubled signs.

issues.title: Hexadecimal numeric tokens
issues.goal: Recognize signed or unsigned 0x/0X with one or more hexadecimal digits; reject incomplete prefix and invalid suffix.
issues.unit_cases: Both prefixes/cases/signs; 0x, 0x1z and hex fractions fail.

issues.title: Non-finite numeric tokens
issues.goal: Recognize Infinity and NaN with permitted leading signs and exact case.
issues.unit_cases: Infinity/+Infinity/-Infinity and NaN/+NaN/-NaN; lowercase and suffix variants fail.

issues.title: Token completion
issues.goal: Reject illegal suffixes and unsupported octal/binary/separator forms; never silently discard bytes or split invalid numeric/identifier spellings into accepted prefixes.
issues.unit_cases: truex, 1foo, 0x1z, 0b1, 1_0 and split-token trivia; valid punctuation boundaries.

issues.title: Owned numeric representation
issues.goal: Retain exact numeric spellings and represent signed decimal/hex and non-finite values without unintended floating-point rounding.
issues.unit_cases: Integers beyond 2^53, huge exponents, negative zero and failure-safe owned storage.

issues.title: Owned value/container model
issues.goal: Provide distinct null/boolean/string/number/array/object alternatives, ordered array elements and observable ordered duplicate object members.
issues.unit_cases: Construct/inspect/move each variant before recursive parsing exists; explicit wrong-type results.

issues.title: Resource guards
issues.goal: Validate limits and account for depth, nodes, members, strings, numeric spelling/exponents, bytes and work before parser growth; cleanup remains bounded.
issues.unit_cases: Below/equal/above bounds and deterministic allocation/work exhaustion without recursive parser dependency.

issues.title: Primitive value dispatcher
issues.goal: Convert completed string, number, null and boolean tokens into owned values; reject other identifiers in value position.
issues.unit_cases: Each primitive root, unknown identifiers and allocation failure; containers still explicitly unsupported at this stage.

issues.title: Recursive container engine
issues.goal: Implement bounded value-dispatch frames for arrays and objects together, with empty containers, nesting and punctuation expectations.
issues.unit_cases: Empty arrays/objects and mixed nesting; allocate/check frames before descent; this step intentionally resolves mutual recursion together.

issues.title: Array element grammar
issues.goal: Complete array element/separator states, heterogeneous ordered elements and one optional trailing comma; reject holes and misplaced separators.
issues.unit_cases: [], mixed values, nested values, [1,]; reject [,], [1,,2] and missing commas.

issues.title: Object member grammar
issues.goal: Complete quoted/identifier name, colon, value and separator states; permit one trailing comma and retain decoded names and every member.
issues.unit_cases: Empty/nested objects, reserved-word/escaped keys and mixed values; reject missing name/colon/value/comma and doubled commas.

issues.title: Duplicate-name policy
issues.goal: Keep all decoded duplicate members by default; optional rejection reports both occurrences. Compare exact decoded names without normalization/case folding.
issues.unit_cases: Quoted/bare/escaped collisions, distinct case and normalization forms, nested object independence.

issues.title: Complete document entry point
issues.goal: Accept one root value of any supported type surrounded by trivia; reject empty/trivia-only input, extra roots and trailing nontrivia.
issues.unit_cases: Every root type, trailing EOF comment, {} {} and junk; atomic errors and reusable context.

issues.title: Checked numeric operations
issues.goal: Provide non-throwing signed/unsigned/floating conversion and exact comparison under documented policies without boolean coercion, rounding/wrapping or locale dependence.
issues.unit_cases: All destination bounds, nonintegral values, huge exponent, nonfinite and mathematical/lexical integer distinctions.

issues.title: Owned document and diagnostics
issues.goal: Expose stable byte spans, warning/error locations and documented views; destruction/moves and input-buffer destruction do not invalidate owned data.
issues.unit_cases: Overwrite input, move/destroy documents, CRLF/non-BMP offsets, failure injection and minimal error fallback.

issues.title: Whole-grammar unit evidence
issues.goal: Map every JSON5 lexical/syntactic production and referenced ES5 alternative to named GoogleTest positive, negative, boundary and truncation cases; exercise resource failures and both exception modes.
issues.unit_cases: No skipped grammar branches; fresh explicit unit evidence for accepted/rejected input and decoded content.

issues.title: Full-support claim
issues.goal: Document language/Unicode versions, permitted limits and all deviations before claiming full JSON5 1.0.0 parsing support.
issues.unit_cases: Review production-to-unit matrix, all preceding contracts and actual native results.

issues.title: Strict JSON syntax mode
issues.goal: Add explicit strict JSON mode for schema documents: quoted keys/double-quoted strings, JSON escapes/numbers/whitespace, no comments/trailing commas/non-finite forms; reject BOM by default with documented optional leading-BOM handling.
issues.unit_cases: Paired JSON/JSON5 fixtures, all JSON grammar branches and mode-specific rejection.

issues.title: Independent schema component and outcomes
issues.goal: Define an optional Draft-07 schema target/API with owned compilation/evaluation state, explicit non-throwing outcomes and bounded work storage. Parser-only consumers acquire no schema dependency. Declare instance-domain handling for duplicate names, non-finite values and unpaired surrogates.
issues.unit_cases: API/storage units and unsupported-instance versus invalid-instance/error categories; no complete validator assumed yet.

issues.title: Schema locations and offline reference registry
issues.goal: Implement URI base identities, pointer escaping and caller-registered local/external resources; no implicit network/filesystem resolution. Compile owned reference graphs with unresolved-reference errors.
issues.unit_cases: Nested $id, relative/absolute references, fragment and ~0/~1 pointers, input/registry destruction.

issues.title: Exact schema equality
issues.goal: Provide type-aware deep equality using exact numeric equivalence, ordered arrays and order-independent unique-name objects.
issues.unit_cases: Equivalent decimal/hex/exponent values; bool versus number; nested/reordered containers.

issues.title: Bounded schema evaluation engine
issues.goal: Evaluate boolean schemas and object schemas with per-type applicability; track branches/references/budgets and recursion progress. Apply Draft-07 $ref behavior, including ignored assertion siblings, without nonprogressing loops.
issues.unit_cases: True/false schemas, recursive instance progress, cyclic references, cleanup/cancellation and minimal errors.

issues.title: Type and equality assertions
issues.goal: Implement type, enum and const, including type unions and mathematical integer semantics independent of token spelling.
issues.unit_cases: Positive/negative/nonapplicable-type cases and exact numeric parity.

issues.title: Numeric assertions
issues.goal: Implement multipleOf, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum and exclusiveMaximum without floating rounding.
issues.unit_cases: Exact fractional divisibility, huge numbers, every inclusive/exclusive bound.

issues.title: String assertions and regex budget
issues.goal: Implement minLength/maxLength in Unicode characters and pattern with the documented compatible regex behavior; reject unsupported conversion/domain and enforce regex work limits.
issues.unit_cases: Supplementary characters, unpaired-unit policy, unanchored patterns, malformed patterns and budget exhaustion.

issues.title: Array assertions
issues.goal: Implement items (schema/tuple), additionalItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems and contains.
issues.unit_cases: Empty/tuple arrays, nested schemas, deep exact uniqueness and matching/nonmatching contains cases.

issues.title: Object assertions
issues.goal: Implement minProperties, maxProperties, required, properties, patternProperties, additionalProperties, dependencies (property/schema) and propertyNames.
issues.unit_cases: Missing fields, overlapping patterns, dynamic names, dependent schemas, unknown fields and type applicability.

issues.title: Logical and conditional assertions
issues.goal: Implement allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not and if/then/else, accounting for all work and distinguishing operational failure from assertion mismatch.
issues.unit_cases: Zero/one/multiple matching branches, nested conditions and failures during branch evaluation.

issues.title: Annotations and extension handling
issues.goal: Expose title/description/default/examples/readOnly/writeOnly and unknown-keyword metadata with valid-branch annotation semantics; never insert defaults or mutate instances. Baseline format/contentEncoding/contentMediaType remain annotations; optional assertions require explicit supported capabilities.
issues.unit_cases: No mutation, failed/not-branch annotation suppression, unknown schema keywords versus unknown instance properties.

issues.title: Public schema compilation and diagnostics
issues.goal: Complete strict-JSON boolean/object schema compilation with the Draft-07 meta-schema, keyword shape/pattern checks and dialect errors. Return instance/schema pointers, keyword and available source spans; support bounded fail-fast/collect-all.
issues.unit_cases: Bootstrap shape checks are component units before this step; final public compiler validates the meta-schema with the completed engine and separates every failure class.

issues.title: Schema conformance and packaging
issues.goal: Run pinned required Draft-07 unit fixtures with offline registered resources, exact-number/Unicode/failure regressions and owned concurrent work contexts. Document dependencies, capabilities and exported schema targets.
issues.unit_cases: Required keyword/reference matrix, OFF exception units, provenance and parser-only independence.

issues.title: CLI dispatch and bounded readers
issues.goal: Prepare optional host command dispatch for file/stdin syntax selection and configured limits; read via injectable bounded I/O interfaces. Define generic validation commands without consumer-specific fields.
issues.unit_cases: Argument and fake I/O units; file errors, unsupported flags and input budget handling; schema flags initially report unavailable.

issues.title: CLI validation and diagnostic protocol
issues.goal: Connect parser and optional compiled-schema validation; provide readable and versioned strict-JSON diagnostics/capabilities. Exit 0 valid, 1 input/assertion/profile invalid, 2 configuration/I/O/operational failure. Encode surrogate/non-finite data safely.
issues.unit_cases: Dispatch/result mapping units, strict-JSON output round-trip, missing schema component and OOM fallback.

issues.title: File-driven example executable
issues.goal: Implement optional adaptive_json5_examples against examples/manifest.json with run/inspect/validate commands, matched expectations and requirement-specific observations; unsupported capabilities never count as passing. Preserve the distinct direct-validation and demonstration-run exit contracts documented in examples/README.md.
issues.unit_cases: Injected readers/reporters, valid/intentional-invalid examples and mismatch/resource outcomes; no e2e CI gate.

issues.title: Host-tool packaging
issues.goal: Expose the example executable behind ADAPTIVE_JSON5_BUILD_EXECUTABLE; install/version it independently, documenting library/executable/test presets. Parser and embedded consumers require no CLI/editor runtime.
issues.unit_cases: CMake target/options review, documented usage and unit capability/version output.

issues.title: VS Code extension package
issues.goal: Prepare a separate extension package with JSON5 language identity/file associations, pinned dependencies, native backend selection and supported versions; do not make it a library dependency.
issues.unit_cases: Package/contribution configuration units; reproducible packaging instructions, no new host-test CI gate.

issues.title: Editor grammar and position mapping
issues.goal: Use grammar fixtures and runtime diagnostics consistently; map original byte spans to documented editor positions, including astral Unicode, combining marks, CRLF and continuations.
issues.unit_cases: Tokenization and range-adapter units with shared parser fixtures.

issues.title: Versioned live documents and provisional recovery
issues.goal: Support unsaved document versions, cancellation and stale-result suppression; provide explicitly provisional recovery for completion/hover without accepting incomplete runtime documents.
issues.unit_cases: Rapid edits/reopen/cancellation and incomplete token/container unit cases.

issues.title: Offline workspace schema associations
issues.goal: Associate file patterns with repository-local schemas per workspace root, without inserting $schema in instances. Resolve registered resources offline; remote access requires explicit configuration.
issues.unit_cases: Two roots, relative references, changed associations and fake network that fails if called.

issues.title: Schema completions
issues.goal: Suggest applicable property names and enum/const/default/example values, required-field hints and quoting-aware insertion, avoiding normal duplicate properties.
issues.unit_cases: Nested/referenced/conditional/union schemas and incomplete-input insertion units.

issues.title: Hover and runtime-parity diagnostics
issues.goal: Show applicable descriptions/types/constraints and agree with runtime exact-number/assertion semantics; expose duplicate, Unicode, root and lexical numeric profile rules separately from generic grammar.
issues.unit_cases: Hover metadata and parser/schema/profile parity units including mathematical versus lexical integer policies.

issues.title: Editor release evidence
issues.goal: Document extension/backend versions and executed tokenization/live-document/range/completion/hover/parity units. Distinguish unit evidence from unexecuted VS Code host acceptance; do not claim unsupported features.
issues.unit_cases: Complete editor-feature-to-unit mapping and unit/format checks only.

issues.title: Finish the C++17 library target and install the public headers
issues.goal: Create a usable namespaced library target for the existing result/error component; publish build/install include paths and C++17 requirements. Install error.hpp and result.hpp, then extend the same package with parser and optional schema targets when implemented. Keep tests OFF for subproject/consumer builds, avoid implicit dependency downloads, and keep host tools separate. Apply exceptions-OFF and RTTI-OFF flags to project targets without changing parent flags. Record pinned source/dependency versions and ABI-affecting options.
issues.unit_cases: Link the existing GoogleTest result suite through the real library target instead of a direct include-directory workaround. Run it with exceptions OFF and RTTI OFF. Record development configure/build/install results for tests-disabled and optional-component configurations; do not add an integration CI gate.

issues.title: Finish pure-memory parsing, concurrent contexts and embedded runtime contracts
issues.goal: Keep parse/value/conversion operations independent of filesystem, network, processes, locale, clocks and OS thread APIs. Share only immutable data; keep mutable parse/work contexts caller-owned. Document the required C++17 runtime, alignment, byte order, integer-size assumptions, initialization and bounded stack/work storage. Connect caller-supplied fallible storage and caller-owned embedded CMake toolchains without requiring a global heap, exceptions, RTTI or host tools.
issues.unit_cases: Run repeated equivalent parses under changed supported locale/environment settings. Run independent valid/failing contexts concurrently using host test threads. Exercise fixed storage, exhaustion and cleanup through no-OS adapters; document unsupported data models/toolchains explicitly. Host passes do not establish device certification or universal embedded support.

issues.title: Finish the optional versioned consumer schema example
issues.goal: Supply the optional version-1 consumer schema and complete valid/invalid example documents outside the core. Use object-root and duplicate-rejection policy only at this profile boundary. Document the reference snapshot revision and unresolved consumer assumptions. Reject unknown fields in fixed objects; apply explicit name/type rules to dynamic environment entries. Configure workspace-local editor association without inserting schema metadata into instances.
issues.unit_cases: Compile the local versioned schema against the local Draft-07 meta-schema. Test a valid example and per-field missing/type/null/pattern/bound/conditional failures, unknown fixed fields and dynamic-name/value rules. Contrast generic primitive/duplicate parsing with profile rejection.

issues.title: Finish optional consumer numeric/string policies and result mapping
issues.goal: Implement a separate consumer adapter selecting mathematical or lexical integer rules, NUL/surrogate/path spelling rules and consumer defaults. Preserve owned input values, empty/ordered arguments and original bytes. Derive argv[0] in the adapter. Map syntax, encoding, duplicate, version, field, conversion and resource failures into the consumer result type without importing ara APIs, filesystem checks or service management into the parser.
issues.unit_cases: Compare 1, 1.0, 1e0, 0x1, +1, fractions, booleans and nonfinite values under each policy. Cover NUL/unpaired-surrogate and lexical traversal rejection, ordered/empty arguments, defaults versus schema annotations and each result mapping using fake consumer/I/O units.

issues.title: Finish release records and reconcile documentation with implemented components
issues.goal: Replace stale no-production-code claims now that result/error headers exist. Reconcile README, architecture, development, verification, requirement sequence, traceability and issue ownership. Record actual supported compiler/toolchain versions and executed GoogleTest/formatting results; preserve historical results as historical. Document source/Unicode/schema versions, limits/deviations, allocator/ABI options, licensing, offline consumption and packaging for components actually shipped. Keep optional schema/CLI/editor/consumer releases separate from a core release.
issues.unit_cases: Check every shipped behavior against named executed GoogleTest cases and every shipped source against the existing formatting check. Keep implemented code, test inventory and executed evidence distinct. Record unsupported/unexecuted compiler/device/editor combinations. Required CI remains one exceptions-OFF GoogleTest job and one formatting job on pull requests.
